units.source_text: 小便完了以后，男人像泄了气的皮球，呆呆地站在滞重的空气中。

en.t: After finishing urinating, the man stood dazed in the heavy air, like a ball that had lost all its air.

units.source_text: 然而，时间的推移，并不能带来什么期待。

en.t: Yet the passage of time brought him nothing to hope for.

units.source_text: 只是无论如何下不了返回屋子的决心。

en.t: He simply could not bring himself to decide to go back into the house.

units.source_text: 那女人身边，该是多么危险呀，一离开，这种感觉更加明显。

en.t: How dangerous it must be beside that woman; the moment he left her, that feeling became even clearer.

units.source_text: 不，其实问题不在于女人本身，而在于那种俯首不语的姿势吧。

en.t: No, the problem was not really the woman herself, but that posture of bowing her head and saying nothing.

units.source_text: 他还从没有看见过这种丧魂落魄的样子。

en.t: He had never before seen anyone look so utterly broken and lost.
He absolutely must not go back.

units.source_text: 说来说去，那种姿势实在太危险了。

en.t: In the end, that posture was simply too dangerous.
